# Macabre & Cheese

> Macabre & Cheese is a coming-soon gothic food truck serving inventive mac and cheese, cheesecakes, and playful comfort food.

Canonical website: https://macabreandcheese.com

## Business

- Legal name: Macabre & Cheese LLC
- Status: Coming soon; no launch date has been announced
- Service areas: Not yet announced
- Cuisine: Mac and cheese, cheesecake, and gothic-inspired comfort food
- Tagline: Eat your feelings. Feed your shadows.

## Menu Preview

- Witches Biscoff Brew: A spiced speculoos cheesecake sealed in a cookie crust.
- The Classic Fairytale: A vanilla bean cheesecake in a golden graham cracker crust.
- The Stout Friar: Mac and cheese with Cotswold cheddar, truffle cheese, and stout béchamel.
- The Slayer: Mozzarella-provolone mac and cheese with San Marzano tomato and roasted garlic sauce.

The displayed menu is a preview and may change before launch.
